text: Arsenal are believed to be confident that England Under-21 attacking midfielder Ethan Nwaneri will sign a new contract despite interest in the 18-year-old from Chelsea and clubs in Germany.

It is thought that Arsenal has confidence in the likelihood of England Under-21 attacking midfielder Ethan Nwaneri agreeing to a new contract, even with interest in the 18-year-old coming from Chelsea and teams in Germany.
After reaching an agreement on personal terms with England international Noni Madueke, Arsenal will also determine whether to proceed with a formal offer for the Chelsea attacker.

According to sources speaking to BBC Sport, discussions with Arsenal are continuing, as the club remains optimistic about finalizing a deal. Their latest offer for the 27-year-old is estimated to be around 70 million euros (£60 million) when add-ons are included.
Arsenal have already submitted an offer to England winger Noni Madueke, 23, who might leave Chelsea in the summer.
